subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do the CI/security owners approve the exact updated action SHAs that execute with repository credentials, particularly `openai/codex-action` and `actions/create-github-app-token`?
rationale: The patch changes pinned third-party code at secret-bearing execution boundaries; source inspection can identify the exposure but cannot establish the repository's intended trust decision.

options.title: Audit and approve the exact pins
options.body: Review the upstream release diffs and SHA provenance for each credential-bearing action, record approval, then merge only the refreshed exact head if required checks pass.

options.title: Hold the credential-bearing updates
options.body: Keep the existing trusted pins and defer this batch until an owner can evaluate the upgraded action revisions.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve the exact pins
recommendation.body: Review the upstream release diffs and SHA provenance for each credential-bearing action, record approval, then merge only the refreshed exact head if required checks pass.
